title: Topic 2
japanese_text:
A：あ〜、結婚までの<u>プロセス</u>とかどうでもいいから、早くいい人と結婚したい！
B：<u>切実だ</u>ね。いい人って？
A：お金持ちで、性格がいい人！
B：そんな人いないって。身近なところで探す方が<u>妥当だ</u>と思うよ。もう出会ってるかもね。「出会いは<u>必然</u>」って言うし。
english_translation: A: Oh, I don't care about the process of marriage, I just want to get married to the right person as soon as I can! B: That's kind of desperate. What do you mean by a good person? A: Someone rich with a good personality! B: There's no one like that. I think it's more reasonable to look for someone nearby. You may have already met them. People say, "Meeting someone is inevitable."
